newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: British Aerospace eyes Philippine market.
newsitem.headline: British Aerospace eyes Philippine market.

text.p: British Aerospace Plc is keen on bidding for contracts due to come up for the Armed Forces of the Philippines (AFP) modernization programme, a British Aerospace official said on Tuesday.

"Right now, we are laying the groundwork so that when the AFP reaches a point where they are looking for proponents, we are in their minds," British Aerospace regional marketing executive Martin Chandler told Reuters.
Chandler said the company was in the process of raising the profile of British Aerospace and its products in the Philippines.
British Aerospace is part of a 24-member trade mission currently visiting the Philippines.
British Aerospace designs, develops and manufactures civil and miltary aircraft, guided weapon systems, guns and ammunition, as well as other high technology aerospace products and systems.
The Philippines launched last December a 15-year plan to modernise its armed forces with President Fidel Ramos signing a congressional resolution setting aside $12.75 billion for the programme.
The navy and air force, considered the most vulnerable areas in the country's defence system, will receive the biggest share of the modernisation budget.
